body.p: I dare notLet me not dare ‸here or anywhere to attempt any statement or definition of Poetry,—or answeringnor answer the question What it is. Like Religion, Love, Nature, while thethese terms are indispensable and we all give a sufficiently definite meaning to them these‸yet same as in their cases, probably‸perhaps as for them, no defiition that has ever been made sufficiently encloses themthe name, nor can any rule possibly made or convention ever so absolutely obtuse but some great exception may resistlessly break througharise andand it overturndisregard it
